support_boundary: Only the pinned official 2FG8 assembly-1 profile and original target A are verified; arbitrary structures/custom profiles and cross-platform execution are not verified.
changes: Replace runtime assertions and numpy testing assertions with explicit conditions/exceptions and finite-array checks.
Refuse existing/symlink comparison reports and use exclusive creation, including under optimized Python.
Validate each zero-exit scan CSV against the 174-site profile, including chain/number/insertion-code/parent identities, diagnostics, finite numeric fields and 12 finite rotamer scores.
Validate CLI metadata configuration, input/output hashes, status/tier counts and rotamer sampling.
Record per-output completeness, failure stage/reason and preserve partial artifacts; code-source preflight failures now also have a journal.

original_execution.scope: Earlier fresh-environment actual preparation and both real scans used the original scripts. Those records were not rewritten or attributed to the revised wrappers.

environment.kind: existing development venv; no dependency downloads/installations

coverage: Normal and python -O comparison: existing report, invalid status/profile, coordinates/atom identity/occupancy, scores/tiers/ranks/rotamers, jointly nonfinite values; valid comparison passes.
Zero-exit simulated CLI: missing rows/files, duplicate/wrong identities, failed/skipped/diagnostic rows, wrong rotamer count/length, NaN/Inf/missing values; complete outputs pass.
Missing/malformed CSV or metadata, metadata hash/count/configuration mismatch, code-preflight failure journal.
Missing CSV from a zero-exit fake CLI propagates nonzero interpreter exit in normal and optimized Python.
not_run: Real preparation or full scientific CLI scans

read_only_existing_output_checks.scope: Apply the revised validator to the previously generated M6.2 CSV/metadata/prepared-input files without executing preparation or scans, and without changing their provenance.

completion_semantics: scans_completed_pending_separate_comparison means both generated outputs passed completeness checks, not historical comparison or scientific validation.
limits: Synthetic control-flow/data validation tests do not replace the prior actual run or demonstrate experimental predictive performance.
The revised driver/comparator were not rerun end-to-end on real inputs in a new environment; this revision does not claim otherwise.
The exact experimental PDB/full construct remains uncertain. No new structure-sensitivity study, protein or ncAA was introduced.
